Cars

Flat boxes with an emoji on top → glossy bodies with real shading, chrome wheels, reflections and a soft shadow under the car. The car is the biggest thing on every screen.

HUD

Plain text buttons → dark glass pills and badges that float over the game world: position, lap, stars, hearts, and a big italic speedo. Nothing pale or app-like.

Buttons

One giant orange PLAY with depth and a hard shadow. Everything else is smaller, darker, and pushed to the edges — a kid's thumb finds PLAY first.

Shop

A list of rows → a garage showroom: spotlight, dark floor, glowing stat bars, paint swatches that recolour the car before you buy.
